responsibility: Defines the FT32 backend’s machine constraints used by reload, instruction matching, and inline asm operand validation. It classifies FT32-specific memory forms for generic versus program-memory address spaces (such as absolute, offset, and register-indirect MEM operands via helpers like ft32_is_mem_pm), and encodes immediate classes for instruction-sized signed, unsigned, branch, bitfield-mask, and bitfield-width constants so patterns in ft32.md can select the correct addressing and instruction forms.
